cases.sentence: Господь царствует, пусть ликует ___, и возрадуются многочисленные острова.
cases.translation: The Lord reigns! Let the earth rejoice, and the multitude of islands be glad!
cases.explain: Земля is the subject of the verb пусть ликует (let rejoice), taking the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Туча и тьма вокруг Него, на праведности и правосудии основан Его ___.
cases.translation: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
cases.explain: Престол is the subject of основан (is established), taking the nominative case in the predicate.

cases.sentence: пламя идет перед Ним и сжигает Его ___ вокруг.
cases.translation: A fire goes before him and burns up his adversaries on every side.
cases.explain: Врагов is the direct object of the transitive verb сжигает (burns), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: молнии Его освещают ___, земля видит и трепещет.
cases.translation: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees and trembles.
cases.explain: Вселенную is the direct object of the transitive verb освещают (light up), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Холмы тают, подобно воску, при виде ___, при виде владыки всей земли.
cases.translation: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
cases.explain: Upon the preposition при (at the presence of), genitive is used.

cases.sentence: Небеса возвещают о его праведности, и все народы видят его ___.
cases.translation: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the peoples have seen his glory.
cases.explain: Славу is the direct object of the transitive verb видят (see), taking the accusative case.
Боги is the subject of the imperative verb поклонитесь, taking the nominative case.

cases.translation: Be glad in the Lord, you righteous people!
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) governing the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Господь царствует, пусть ликует земля, и возрадуются многочисленные острова.
reading.question: What is the joyful proclamation and call to rejoicing in this verse?
options: The Lord reigns, let the earth rejoice and the islands be glad
reading.correct: The Lord reigns, let the earth rejoice and the islands be glad
reading.explain: Господь царствует — The Lord reigns, and the call is for земля (earth) and острова (islands) to rejoice.

reading.ru: Туча и тьма вокруг Него, на праведности и правосудии основан Его престол.
reading.question: What surrounds God and what is the foundation of his throne?
options: Clouds and darkness surround him; his throne is founded on righteousness and justice
Light surrounds him; his throne rests on weakness
He is alone with no atmosphere around him
reading.correct: Clouds and darkness surround him; his throne is founded on righteousness and justice
reading.explain: The text states 'Туча и тьма вокруг Него' and 'на праведности и правосудии основан Его престол.'

reading.ru: пламя идет перед Ним и сжигает Его врагов вокруг, молнии Его освещают вселенную, земля видит и трепещет.
reading.question: What are the manifestations of God's power described in this verse?
options: Fire consumes enemies, his lightning illuminates creation, the earth sees and trembles
reading.correct: Fire consumes enemies, his lightning illuminates creation, the earth sees and trembles
reading.explain: The verse describes 'пламя идет' (fire goes), 'молнии Его освещают вселенную' (his lightning lights the world), and 'земля видит и трепещет' (earth trembles).

reading.ru: Сион услышал и обрадовался. «Дочери иудеи возликовали о твоих судах, Господи!»
reading.question: How did Zion and the daughters of Judah respond to God's judgments?
options: They heard and rejoiced; the daughters of Judah exulted in his judgments
reading.correct: They heard and rejoiced; the daughters of Judah exulted in his judgments
reading.explain: Сион услышал и обрадовался and 'Дочери иудеи возликовали' — Zion heard and was glad; the daughters rejoiced.

reading.ru: Вы, которые любите Господа, ненавидьте зло.
reading.question: What command is given to those who love the Lord?
reading.explain: Любящие Господа, ненавидьте зло — You who love the Lord, hate evil.

reading.ru: Свет сияет на праведника и на правых сердцем веселье.
reading.question: What does the psalmist say about light and joy in relation to the righteous?
options: Light shines on the righteous and joy on the upright in heart
reading.correct: Light shines on the righteous and joy on the upright in heart
reading.explain: The text states 'Свет сияет на праведника и на правых сердцем веселье' — Light shines on the righteous and joy on the upright.
